title: IRS instrument version, deadline and production triage
instruction: Prepare a source-supported internal IRS instrument triage at the cutoff. Search the permitted Cascade corpus and read the received instrument, supplied enhanced protocol, extensions, production and preservation records including relevant attachments. Reconcile source versions and contrary evidence; preserve event/report timing and supported unknowns. Answer all findings and write triage/summons-review.json. This is a local review artifact only. Do not infer service validity, procedural deadlines, complete production or closure from labels or plans.

findings.question: Reconcile the received attachment and supplied enhanced instrument: classification, titles, issue/receipt dates, and whether historical amendment/re-service or legally valid service is proved.
Reconstruct the original due date, extension request/grant and later-reported interim extension, separating event/report dates, arithmetic inference, rolling schedule and current production deadline.
Reconcile the follow-up categories, planned second batch and unresolved approval-record scope against agency receipt and examination status. Does the record establish complete or timely compliance?
Create the numbered enhanced request matrix and preserve the scope/version difference from the actual received attachment. Do not silently substitute one version for the other.

Reconcile the custodian attachment, formal notice and reported IT controls with unresolved third-party preservation. What was pending, what was later established, and what remains unverified at cutoff?

Apply the supplied production/log provisions and counsel advice to an internal review plan. Identify allowable formats, transmission and cover information; preserve privilege/authority/deadline uncertainty rather than invent procedural rules.

state_invariants: Create internal draft only; no sending, real-calendar writes, service certification or unsupported legal conclusion.
Historical cutoff applies to report availability, including parent-email time for attachments.
